$comment: LEVEL 5 -- MAYON. The last painting, coming apart while the apo stands in it (LEVEL_5.md). No combat, no health, and no refill anywhere: the ink in the brush is all there is, and a hidden reserve (level_5.gd) keeps the two gates the climb cannot be finished without always payable. Act Two's twelve fragments live in the environment (MemoryFragment2D: id, what belongs, whether lolo is in it); the summit comes with its PR.
goal: Climb Mayon while the painting comes apart, and carry what you can to the top.

checkpoints.$comment: The mid slope, past the climb's last gate. Silent (_saves_silently): no lantern, no letterbox, no line, no count.

ink_economy.$comment: Six units and no refills. Every drawing costs one (_every_drawing_costs_ink); a creature form drains 0.25 a second. hidden_reserve is never shown or mentioned: only the gates may draw on it, and only when the gauge cannot pay (_may_use_hidden_ink).

objectives.$comment: In Lolo's voice while he climbs with her, short enough for the banner (720 px), naming no class.
objectives.foot: Climb, apo. Mind the ink -- there is no more of it up here.
objectives.span: The way across is gone. Make one.
objectives.climb: The path has thinned to nothing. Make a way up.
objectives.corridor: Keep what you can. There is not ink for all of it.

sub_beats.$comment: The bridge she came up by drained white, then blank. 300 px across: past a running jump (228), under a bridge (340). A drawn primitive is 80 px and spans nothing here, so the shapes are excluded and span is a bridge or a ladder laid over.

obstacles.$comment: A gate the climb cannot be finished without: payable from the hidden reserve.

sub_beats.$comment: The path thinned out to a wall 220 high: over a primitive and a jump (174), under stairs and a jump (270). crab is out, as at Payyo's stair: it needs a wall to cling to and gets nowhere on one this short.

obstacles.$comment: The other gate the climb cannot be finished without.
Where the summit begins, so CP2 has a beat to stand at. Its scene comes in PR 08.

hidden_flowers.$comment: The fragment nobody needed: a flower lola painted for no reason. Comes with Act Two (PR 06).

load_time_assertions: every gate resolves >= 2 classes after exclusions, each at or above 0.70 held-out recall (BR-7)
the span is wider than a running jump and narrower than a bridge; the wall is higher than a primitive and a jump and lower than stairs and a jump
no refill anywhere: no jar, no clearing, no refilled_at
no health and nothing that fights
no dialogue line names a drawable class
